## Behavior
As a VideoML visitor, I can explore representative framework demos without running Babulus.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given selected demos from Babulus examples and renderer registry, when migrated, then their assets, dependencies, and frame-driven controls run in a standalone VideoML fixture. Include representative Anime.js, Three.js, Lottie, D3, p5, and existing frame-driven motion examples where support is verified. No Babulus auth or voiceover is required.

## Ownership
stdlib, player, toolchain, videoml-org; Babulus as consumer

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
